17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 4940-42 North Sheridan Road, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District
Lot Area: Approximately 8,729.1 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to convert commercial space on the building's
first floor into six (6) residential units. The resulting building will be fully
residential and contain thirteen (13) dwelling units total. The height and
footprint of the existing three-story building will remain without change.
The subject property is a Transit Served Location and will not provide off-
street parking. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative
Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE and 17-13-
1101-B of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
reduce the residential off-street parking ratio from 46.15% (3 parking
spaces) to zero, reduce the rear setback for floors containing residential uses
from 30 ft. to zero, and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed
by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans .

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 22,235 square feet (2.55 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 671.46 square feet per D.U.
(13 dwelling units total)

© The amount of off-street parking: zero

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location based on its
proximity to the Sheridan Bus Route and the CTA Argyle Rail Station. Pursuant
to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking
ratio from 46.15% (3 parking spaces) to zero.

() Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: zero (existing)
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: zero (existing)
South Side: zero (existing)
c. *Rear Setback: zero ft. (existing)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-B, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the rear setback
from 30 ft. to zero.

(E) Building Height: 42.5 feet (existing)
